# Chapter 4: Democracies and Democratization

## 4.1: What is Democracy?

::: callout-note
### Learning Objectives

By the end of this section, you will be able to:

- Define democracy and distinguish between procedural and substantive conceptions of democratic rule.
- Identify the key institutional features of parliamentary, presidential, and semi-presidential democracies.
- Analyze the major theories and historical waves of democratization.
:::
